name: player_process_primary_gun_dispatch_request
description: Player::ProcessPrimaryGunDispatchTick updates primary controller scroll models, consumes a primary fire request, decrements ammo, spawns the auxiliary primary-fire runtime effect, applies recoil to the selected fire slot, increments the local HUD dispatch counter, and falls through to primary weapon variant toggle when ammo is exactly empty.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly/HLIL inspection in the current session verified the scroll-texture update prelude, primaryGunDispatchRequested gate and clear, SelectPrimaryGunFirePointAndSlot dependency, positive-ammo decrement and clamp, sentinel-ammo skip, EnsureGunAuxEffectActive call using primaryFireOrigin, local dispatch counter increment, recoil slot offset gate, and exact-zero HandlePrimaryWeaponVariantToggleInput(0x31) fallback.

The native smoke checks the no-dispatch early return plus local dispatch latch clear, ammo decrement, runtime effect allocation from the free list, primaryFireOrigin propagation, preset gunFireDir propagation, recoil slot offset, and HUD counter increment.
No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x43a400 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to the coherent player weapon/source-cluster pass.
